page_title: Item:Legendary Helm of the Sun's Wrath

enchantments.tooltip: Crown of Summer: You permanently benefit from Crown of Summer.Crown of Summer: You have a +15 Positive Healing Amplification, and you gain 10 Melee Power and 5 Ranged Power (all enhancement bonus).
Legendary Accuracy +5: Passive: +5 Legendary bonus to attack rolls
Seeker +14: Provides a +14 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +14 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Armor-Piercing 23%: Passive: +23% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
